name: Vikash Sharma

about: I'm a Frontend Developer at Dazzlebirds Web Solutions, focused on building responsive, user-friendly websites and translating design concepts into polished digital experiences.

My experience includes HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, and WordPress development. I enjoy turning complex design requirements into clean, maintainable interfaces that work seamlessly across devices.
I'm currently expanding my expertise in React.js and modern frontend development, with a focus on reusable components, API integration, and building interactive web applications.
I believe great frontend development combines thoughtful design, reliable functionality, and attention to detail.
